PHYSICAL EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.
   B. Damage equipment used for Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.
   C. Practise Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.

2. Best practice when working on Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   B. Practise Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.

   B. Refuse all feedback on Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t.

   D. Practise Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

   C. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.

   B. The speed of the music

   B. Refuse all feedback on Shot put.
